## The idea

## The limitation it turns on

Every chapter here is built around a wall the reader hits before being handed the tool that clears
it — one neuron draws one line, a bag of words cannot see negation. What is the wall in your idea,
and how would a reader *observe* it rather than be told about it?

## Can the app demonstrate it today?

Be honest here, because this is usually where the work is. Three of the five existing chapters were
at some point blocked by the app being unable to produce the phenomenon they describe, and each time
the fix was engine or data work, not rewording. If your idea needs a new layer type, a new dataset,
or a metric that isn't measured yet, say so — that is useful information, not a reason not to file.

## Anything you've already measured

Numbers and over how many runs, if you tried it.
